dataset_name: iGOT Karmayogi — 40 Role Competency & Learning Dataset
source_notes: Programme/role metadata, competency mappings, descriptions, learning outcomes, course names and supplied durations are source-derived according to the uploaded README.
Role-course relationships and normalized role IDs are structured from the uploaded README.
Synthetic module/learning-item structures are retained and explicitly marked synthetic.

roles.title: STATISTICAL INVESTIGATOR GRADE I
roles.programme_description: Comprehensive assessment programme for Statistical Investigator Grade I. The programme combines office procedures with statistical, digital, cybersecurity and professional-effectiveness learning.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved understanding of office procedures; stronger statistical and data-visualization capability; advanced spreadsheet use; safer digital behaviour; foundational AI awareness; and improved time management.

roles.title: STATISTICAL INVESTIGATOR GRADE II
roles.programme_description: Comprehensive assessment programme for Statistical Investigator Grade II focused on office procedures together with statistical, communication, workplace-behaviour and digital capabilities.
roles.learning_outcomes: Better statistical and visualization skills, professional communication, workplace emotional management, document-production capability, cyber-safety awareness and foundational AI knowledge.

roles.title: JOINT SECRETARY LEVEL OFFICER / DIRECTOR
official_competency_mapping: Functional → Digital Fluency → Digital Service Design
roles.programme_description: Comprehensive assessment for Joint Secretary-level officers and Directors, combining leadership, ethical public service, data protection, evidence-based policy, cybersecurity and data-science learning.
roles.learning_outcomes: Stronger digital-service orientation, evidence-based policy capability, awareness of data-protection requirements, cybersecurity awareness, leadership and data-science literacy for policy decisions.

roles.title: SENIOR TECHNICAL DIRECTOR
roles.programme_description: Senior technical leadership assessment emphasizing logical decision-making, data-driven management, procurement, team effectiveness, data-centre awareness and IT project lifecycle management.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved reasoning and decision-making, awareness of procurement processes, stronger team-management ability, understanding of data-centre environments and project lifecycle practices.

roles.title: DEPUTY SECRETARY
official_competency_mapping: Functional → Digital Fluency → Digital Service Design
roles.programme_description: Comprehensive assessment for Deputy Secretary-level responsibilities, integrating team management, data-driven decision-making, evidence-based policy, interpersonal effectiveness, information security and AI.
roles.learning_outcomes: Better digital-service orientation, evidence-based administrative decision-making, stronger interpersonal and team skills, improved information-security awareness and foundational AI understanding.

roles.title: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR / RESEARCH OFFICER (ADCO/RO)
roles.programme_description: Assessment programme combining office-management requirements with leadership, problem solving, statistical visualization, security operations, public administration and AI/ML learning.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved team leadership, problem solving, statistical interpretation, security awareness, public-administration understanding and ability to recognize AI/ML applications.

roles.title: ASSISTANT REGISTRAR GENERAL (SOCIAL STUDIES)
official_competency_mapping: Functional → Cabinet Note Preparation → Cabinet Note Writing
roles.programme_description: Comprehensive assessment programme for an ARG-level social-studies role, combining Cabinet Note preparation, leadership, AI and data-driven decision-making.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved Cabinet Note preparation, inter-ministerial consultation awareness, team management, data interpretation, statistical decision-making and AI literacy.

roles.title: DIRECTOR GENERAL, FORESTRY RESEARCH ORGANISATION
roles.provider: Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education
roles.programme_description: Senior forestry-research leadership programme focused on digital platforms, AI-enabled agricultural transformation and effective communication.
roles.learning_outcomes: Understanding of PM Gati Shakti tools, AI applications in agriculture and stronger professional communication.

roles.title: SENIOR POLICE OFFICER (25+ YEARS SERVICE)
roles.programme_description: Assessment programme for senior police officers with more than 25 years of service, using computer vision as the principal technology-learning component.
roles.learning_outcomes: Foundational understanding of computer vision, AI-enabled digital transformation and responsible use of vision systems.

roles.title: DIRECTOR / DEPUTY SECRETARY EQUIVALENT
roles.programme_description: Senior administrative programme covering commerce and industry, trade agreements, WTO, PPP, leadership, emerging technology and public outreach.
roles.learning_outcomes: Better understanding of trade-policy concepts, PPP, leadership, emerging technologies and citizen/stakeholder communication.

roles.title: MAP ANALYST
roles.programme_description: Advanced assessment programme for map-analysis work combining communication and professional effectiveness with SQL, MySQL, database design and information security.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved presentation and reporting, stronger interpersonal skills, SQL/database capability and awareness of information-security principles.

roles.title: RESEARCH ANALYST
roles.programme_description: Research-analyst assessment combining AI awareness, environmental responsibility and workplace motivation.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved understanding of AI, responsible e-waste handling, workplace motivation and collaborative behaviour.

roles.title: SYSTEM ANALYST
roles.provider: Controller General of Patents, Designs & Trade Marks
official_competency_mapping: Functional → Data Analytics → Data Analysis & Visualization
Digital Fluency → Digital Tools (MS Office, Excel & PPT) & Platforms
roles.programme_description: System-analyst assessment combining data analytics and digital-tools capability with data protection, backup/recovery and policy insight.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved data-analysis and visualization capability, stronger understanding of backup/recovery and greater ability to derive policy insights from data.

roles.title: SENIOR SYSTEM ANALYST / DEPUTY DIRECTOR / UNDER SECRETARY / ASSISTANT REGISTRAR / PPS / AD / SENIOR AO
official_competency_mapping: Functional → Public Procurement (GFR) → Procurement Management through GeM
Functional → Handling RTI Matters → RTI Records Management
Functional → Cabinet Note Preparation → Cabinet Note Writing
Functional → Office Management → Noting & Drafting of Official Communications
roles.programme_description: Multi-designation assessment programme combining Cabinet Notes, RTI administration, public procurement and official noting/drafting.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved capability in Cabinet Note preparation, RTI records management, GeM/GFR-based procurement and official government communication.

roles.title: TECHNICAL OFFICER
roles.provider: Institute of Wood Science and Technology, Bengaluru
roles.programme_description: Technical-officer assessment focused on responsive service delivery, e-governance, IT security and goal setting.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved responsiveness, understanding of secure e-governance practices and clearer goal-setting and performance orientation.

roles.title: TECHNICAL PERSONNEL
official_competency_mapping: Domain → Resources → Environment, Forest and Climate Change
roles.programme_description: Technical-personnel programme combining environmental/forestry capability with emotional intelligence and modern nursery-management practices.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved interpersonal effectiveness, understanding of biodegradable waste management and awareness of modern nursery technologies.

roles.title: CHIEF TECHNICAL OFFICER
roles.provider: Institute of Wood Science and Technology, Bengaluru
official_competency_mapping: Behavioural → Service Orientation → Service Excellence (wrt citizens)
roles.programme_description: Chief Technical Officer assessment emphasizing citizen-facing service excellence, time management, workplace relationships and national-development awareness.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved prioritization, workplace relationship management and citizen-centric service orientation.

roles.title: ASSISTANT DIRECTOR, CENSUS OPERATIONS (TECHNICAL)
roles.programme_description: The assessment evaluates analytical, communication, technical and digital-governance competencies through six domains: Critical Thinking, Speaking Effectively, advanced MS PowerPoint, Government e-Marketplace, Basics of AI and GIS. The source describes 120 structured questions, 20 per module, and emphasizes reasoning, presentation, procurement, AI awareness and spatial-data understanding.
roles.learning_outcomes: Enhanced critical-thinking and reasoned judgement; stronger public speaking; advanced PowerPoint presentation ability; understanding of GeM; foundational AI knowledge; and basic GIS/spatial-data understanding.

roles.title: SENIOR TECHNICAL OFFICER
roles.provider: Institute of Wood Science and Technology, Bengaluru
roles.programme_description: Senior technical-officer assessment focused on responsiveness, time management, workplace relationships and secure e-governance.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved prioritization, professional workplace relationships, IT-security awareness and responsive service delivery.

roles.title: CHIEF TECHNICAL OFFICER
roles.programme_description: Chief Technical Officer assessment combining forest-management knowledge, time management and office procedures.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved understanding of forest management and valuation, stronger time management and clearer outcome/goal orientation.

roles.title: SENIOR RESEARCH OFFICER (SOCIAL STUDIES)
official_competency_mapping: Functional → Data Analytics → Data-led Decision Making
roles.programme_description: Advanced social-studies research assessment centered on data-led decision-making and supported by social-development, statistical, AI, Cabinet Note and time-management learning.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved data analysis, evidence-based government decisions, AI awareness, social-policy understanding and Cabinet Note preparation.

roles.title: MAP OFFICER
roles.programme_description: Map-officer assessment focused on project planning, leadership, responsible data management, design thinking and SDGs.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved project planning and management, leadership, ethical data handling, citizen-oriented problem solving and SDG awareness.

roles.title: EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR / DIRECTOR (AUCTIONS)
roles.programme_description: Executive-level programme emphasizing service orientation, communication, emerging technologies, trade and strategic awareness.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved responsiveness, public/stakeholder communication, emerging-technology awareness and understanding of trade and development priorities.

roles.title: CHAIRMAN-CUM-MANAGING DIRECTOR / EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR
roles.programme_description: Senior executive programme linking public-policy writing and national-development awareness with AI-enabled public-service delivery.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved policy-writing capability and understanding of responsible AI applications for government service delivery and efficiency.

roles.title: QUALITY ASSURANCE OFFICER
official_competency_mapping: Functional → Information & Communication Management → Dissemination of Information
roles.programme_description: Competency-based learning plan for a Quality Assurance Officer spanning textile-industry practices, QMS/TQM, quality tools, project management, business-process management, technical writing, trade and change management.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved quality-management capability, process-improvement skills, technical/scientific writing, project planning, business-process understanding and change-management ability.

roles.title: AIS OFFICER
official_competency_mapping: Functional → Data Analytics → Data Analysis & Visualization
roles.programme_description: Assessment for AIS officers in the Department of Space combining contract management, data analytics and emerging technology applications in finance.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved contract-management knowledge, data-analysis awareness and understanding of blockchain and AI in financial contexts.

roles.title: ASSISTANT SECTION OFFICER
roles.programme_description: Assistant Section Officer assessment combining core office procedures with problem solving, team coordination, governance analytics, public administration and cybersecurity.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved file/office procedures, problem solving, team coordination, governance analytics and cybersecurity awareness.

roles.title: SECTION OFFICER
roles.programme_description: Section Officer assessment centred on office procedures and supported by problem solving, team management, AI/ML/DL, public administration and cybersecurity.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved administrative procedures, decision-making, team management, AI literacy and secure digital working practices.

roles.title: DEPUTY REGISTRAR GENERAL (MAPS)
roles.programme_description: Senior maps-administration assessment combining project implementation with leadership, data-driven government, critical information infrastructure, ISMS and evidence-based policy.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved project implementation, leadership, data-driven decision-making, information-security management and policy evaluation.

roles.title: ADDITIONAL REGISTRAR GENERAL
roles.programme_description: Senior leadership assessment emphasizing transformational leadership, ethical public service, data protection, evidence-based policy, cybersecurity and data science.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved team leadership and motivation, ethical governance, data-privacy awareness, evidence-based policy skills, cybersecurity awareness and data-science literacy.

roles.title: DEPUTY REGISTRAR GENERAL (SOCIAL STUDIES)
official_competency_mapping: Functional → Data Analytics → Data-led Decision Making
roles.programme_description: Social-studies senior assessment focused on data-led decision-making, critical thinking, digital literacy and public administration.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved evidence-based decision-making, critical analysis, digital literacy and application of data in social/governance contexts.

roles.title: DEPUTY REGISTRAR GENERAL (CENSUS & TRAINING)
roles.programme_description: Senior census-and-training assessment combining motivation, team leadership, project management, data science, cybersecurity and data protection.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved ability to inspire teams, manage projects, use data for policy, protect information and understand data-protection obligations.

roles.title: RESEARCH OFFICER (DRAWING) / MAP OFFICER
roles.programme_description: Assessment programme combining data management and geospatially relevant technical work with SQL, MySQL, project management and responsible data practices.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved database and SQL capability, responsible data management, project execution and team/leadership skills.

roles.title: GEOGRAPHER
roles.programme_description: Advanced geographer assessment combining personal effectiveness with report writing, database design, SQL, interpersonal skills and information security.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved stress management, reporting, interpersonal effectiveness, SQL/database skills and secure handling of information.

roles.title: MTS -- ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT
official_competency_mapping: Functional → Administration Matters → Handling Allowances & Reimbursement
roles.programme_description: APAR 2025--26 comprehensive assessment for MTS. The source explains that the Comprehensive Assessment Framework evaluates competency attainment through assessments based on courses assigned by MDOs.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved routine/supportive task execution, procedural compliance, documentation, time/resource management, service assistance and identification of skill gaps.

roles.title: MTS -- DEPARTMENTAL SUPPORT
roles.provider: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying
roles.programme_description: MTS assessment designed to evaluate functional and operational capabilities such as task execution, procedural compliance, time management, record keeping, office coordination and adherence to rules and protocols.
roles.learning_outcomes: Efficient routine/supportive work, accurate procedure-following, effective communication, coordination, service assistance and identification of competency gaps.

roles.title: LAB ATTENDANT / DRIVER
official_competency_mapping: Functional → Administration Matters → Handling Allowances & Reimbursement
roles.programme_description: APAR programme titled Courses for Lab Attendant Driver. The About text refers to APAR courses for LDC/UDC staff of IHM Gurdaspur under the Ministry of Tourism. The programme combines citizen engagement, service awareness, rules, ministry awareness, cybersecurity and computer capability.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved administrative awareness, citizen engagement, digital safety, basic computer operation, troubleshooting and knowledge of ministry/service rules.

roles.title: SCIENTIST B / SCIENTIST C
roles.programme_description: Comprehensive final assessment integrating strategic communication, cyber resilience and administrative excellence. It tests the interplay between secure digital infrastructure, precise noting/drafting and professional communication.
roles.learning_outcomes: Application of the CIA Triad and risk frameworks; precise government documentation; evaluation of AI-driven cyber threats and ransomware; use of OODA for resilience; active listening; communication-barrier management; assertive conflict resolution; collaborative leadership.

roles.title: SCIENTIST G / SENIOR SCIENTIST
roles.programme_description: Advanced Scientist G assessment combining team leadership and mentoring with design thinking, project management, generative AI, R-based data analysis and integrated digital services/cybersecurity.
roles.learning_outcomes: Improved teamwork, leadership and mentoring; citizen-centred problem solving; project planning and execution; responsible use of GenAI; statistical/data analysis in R; and secure digital-service use.

roles.title: JOINT SECRETARY AND ABOVE
roles.programme_description: Comprehensive APAR assessment for Joint Secretary and above, designed to strengthen strategic leadership and governance through data-informed decision-making, ethical standards, recruitment-rule oversight and regulatory alignment.
roles.learning_outcomes: Use data and performance indicators for strategic decisions; uphold AIS Conduct Rules; provide oversight on Recruitment Rules; strengthen accountability, integrity and long-term institutional effectiveness.
